original_ai_output.title_zh: 拉各斯州称力争在2027年雨季前实现90%防洪目标
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 拉各斯州政府表示，计划通过建设韧性基础设施和全年排水系统维护，在2027年雨季前实现90%至95%的防洪成功率。环境与水资源专员Tokunbo Wahab在视察奥雷贡、苏鲁莱雷和伊科伊Osborne Foreshore Estate的项目及争议地点时披露了这一目标。Wahab称，过去几年该州防洪成功率在75%至80%之间，正通过追加基础设施和环境政策加以提升。

location.raw_text: Oregun, Surulere and Osborne Foreshore Estate, Ikoyi, Lagos State

key_facts.fact: 拉各斯州政府称力争在2027年雨季前实现90%至95%的防洪成功率
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: targeting between 90 and 95 per cent success in flood control ahead of the 2027 rainy season through resilient infrastructure and year-round drainage maintenance

key_facts.fact: 环境与水资源专员Tokunbo Wahab在视察奥雷贡、苏鲁莱雷和伊科伊Osborne Foreshore Estate的项目及争议地点时披露该目标
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Commissioner for the Environment and Water Resources, Tokunbo Wahab, disclosed this during an inspection of projects and disputed sites in Oregun, Surulere and Osborne Foreshore Estate, Ikoyi, on Saturday

key_facts.fact: 该州称过去几年防洪成功率为75%至80%
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the state had recorded between 75 and 80 per cent success in tackling flooding over the past few years

uncertainties: 防洪目标为州政府单方面表述，尚未获独立验证
